provenance.question: is the single training pair a lucky draw, is regret misaligned with decoding, and does pooling the per-pair thetas help?
provenance.training_pairs: 8 cross-subject pairs inside subjects 0-4; SUBJECT-DISJOINT from the test subjects 5-9
provenance.regret: EXACT full-grid POT: R(theta) = <c(theta), pi_hat> - OT(c(theta)); never a restricted edge set, so the 'certificate was an artefact of F_p' explanation is testable here
provenance.pooling: coordinate-wise mean of the per-pair thetas over the first k pairs (k = 1,2,4,8), renormalised; plus a validation-ranked selection over every candidate
provenance.selection: 6 validation pairs from TRAINING subjects; the test pairs take no part
provenance.metric: geodesic miss@5% on the 8 held-out pairs
provenance.memory: one n x n cost and one n x n geodesic matrix at a time; ~32 MB each at n=2000
